serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
#bot.Expression.Clear
#bot.Expression.happy
You: Are you excited to finally meet those friends Annalie always talks about?
Bot: I sure am! 
Bot: I wonder what kind of people they are.
You: They own a cafe and travel all the time so they are stacked. Probably more than we are.
Bot: I’m more interested in their characters! They are Annalie’s friends, after all.
You: You are right. There must be something wrong with them.
Bot: There’s that too, I guess.
Bot: As far as I remember Annalie told us they travel all around the world. Aren’t you curious about what they went through in all those places?
You: Sure, I wouldn’t mind a story or two. 
Bot: I never had a chance to travel around the world. Do you know how it is like?
You: No idea, I was poor my whole life so there’s no way I could’ve afforded such a lifestyle. Plane tickets are expensive as fuck because of all of those new taxes.
You: Heads up, we are already at the place.
